meta.title: PartiDesign: how a design is counted as a success
meta.subtitle: Refold the design, apply the benchmark's thresholds, divide into one GPU-day

cards.title: The four thresholds a protein binder must clear at once
items: Binder pLDDT above 0.8 on a 0-1 scale: the model is confident about the binder's own fold
Interface pTM above 0.5 and interface predicted aligned error below 10.85 A: it is confident about how binder and target sit together
Bound-unbound RMSD below 3.5 A: the binder keeps the same shape when the target is taken away

The same complex-monomer prediction pair must satisfy all four. Protein and peptide designs use AlphaFold2 initial guess; proteins designed against nucleic acids or ligands use ESMFold2-standard; nucleic-acid designs use AlphaFold 3

cards.title: What 'designs per GPU-day' actually measures
items: Every cost was timed on one RTX 4090-48G: generation per candidate (a batch of 16, divided by 16), one MPNN redesign, and a complete refold. Those are combined with the measured pass rate and divided into 86,400 seconds

So the headline number rewards a cheap generator as much as an accurate one. A second sequence per backbone can raise the chance a backbone succeeds while lowering the daily count, because it costs another full refold

The timing boundary excludes model loading, compilation, warmup, CPU feature processing, host-device transfer, file I/O and scheduling. PartiDesign was timed at 400 flow steps, RFdiffusion3 at 200 sampler steps, BoltzGen at 500 steps with three recycles and 16 diffusion samples

cards.title: Where the advantage does not hold
items: With eight ordinary MPNN draws per backbone, PXDesign has a higher successful-backbone rate than PartiDesign alpha, reversing the single-draw ordering. The win is conditioned on the budget protocol, not independent of it
Secondary-structure guidance helps unevenly: alpha conditioning raises successful backbones from 102 to 202 of 284 for PDL1 and 227 to 286 of 324 for IR, but drops 120 to 116 of 164 for BHRF1
Two targets stay near zero under every condition: 5 of 164 backbones for the SARS-CoV-2 RBD and 2 of 284 for TNF-alpha
The beta condition scores below unguided PartiDesign throughout
